title: How to Make $120k/Year with An Army of AI Influencers
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The whole video is a walkthrough of Higgsfield (spelled 'Higsfield' in the transcript). It ends with a call to 'go check out Higsfield'. The payout route shown is Higgsfield's own affiliate 'Earn' programme, which needs the caption 'Made in AI influencer studio on hickfield.ai'. The host gives no figures for his own AI influencer income. The $120k/year in the title never appears in the transcript.

stated_problem.quote: Now, believe it or not, I'm actually not super comfortable showing my face on camera.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Faceless AI influencer accounts
idea.one_liner: Make an AI-generated influencer character in Higgsfield, post short videos of it on Instagram/YouTube/Facebook/TikTok, and earn from platform creator payouts and Higgsfield's per-view affiliate 'Earn' campaigns.
idea.customer: Social media viewers (the audience); payers are the platforms' creator programmes and Higgsfield's affiliate programme
idea.offer: Short-form entertainment videos starring a visually striking AI character, sometimes driven by the founder's own recorded performance
idea.revenue_model: Platform revenue share (RPM per 1,000 views) plus Higgsfield Earn affiliate payouts per post, scaled by views

key_quotes.quote: But if I could delay that realization for just a few seconds, then it will make a massive difference.
But Higsfield will pay you because they can get more Higsfield customers from your post.
So, this is really the only way that I know of where you can actually monetize Instagram reels directly.
The more views you get, the bigger your payout.
I would want to inject my personality into it.

claims.claim: AI influencer owners reportedly make thousands to millions of dollars a year
claims.quote: making thousands and sometimes millions of dollars a year posting AI generated content with an AI generated person

claims.claim: Generating the influencer character cost 2 credits
claims.quote: this is going to cost me two credits, which is basically nothing to generate the influencer.
And we're going to generate it for eight credits.

claims.claim: A new page needs at least 1,000 views and three posts to qualify for Higgsfield Earn
claims.quote: if you do use a brand new page, it has to have at least 1,000 views and three posts.
Facebook will pay you between 10 cents and 30 cents per thousand views.

claims.claim: The host makes $50-$500 per Facebook reel on his own (non-AI) content
claims.quote: And so it's not uncommon for me to make $50 to $500 for a Facebook reel.
YouTube pays between 5 cents and 35 cents per thousand views on the short form videos.
On long form videos, which you could use Higfield for as well, they pay you between $4 and $25 per thousand views.

claims.claim: TikTok pays $0.30-$3 RPM for videos over a minute
claims.quote: They'll pay you between 30 cents and $3 per thousand views.

acquisition_channels.details: Posts AI influencer reels/shorts on Instagram (and YouTube/Facebook/TikTok). Relies on eye-catching character design to get retention and algorithmic reach.
Connects the Instagram account to Higgsfield Earn by putting a code in the bio, then submits post links to active campaigns for payouts to PayPal.

ideas.delivery: The solo creator designs the character in Higgsfield's AI Influencer Studio, then generates videos from library clips or their own recorded performance. They download the videos, post them with the required caption, and submit the links. Content is fully digital and made by the creator plus the AI tool.
ideas.other_uk_rules: ASA/CAP Code and CMA guidance require clear ad/affiliate disclosure (e.g. #ad) on paid Higgsfield promo posts. Platform rules on labelling AI-generated content also apply. Income must be declared to HMRC.

idea.name: AI stand-up comedy influencer page
idea.one_liner: A comedy page fronted by an AI-generated comedian character, earning from platform payouts and affiliates.
idea.offer: Comedy short-form videos performed by an AI character

key_quotes.quote: You could do like a standup comedy influencer.
You could use this for comedy pages.

ideas.delivery: The creator writes jokes and AI generates the performing character's videos.
ideas.other_uk_rules: ASA disclosure rules for any affiliate or sponsored posts

idea.name: AI brand mascots / virtual models
idea.one_liner: Create AI-generated brand mascots or virtual models for brands to use in their content.
idea.offer: An AI character used as a mascot or model in brand content
idea.revenue_model: not stated (likely fee per character/content package)

key_quotes.quote: You could have brand mascots or virtual models, faceless niche pages.

ideas.delivery: The creator builds the AI character and generates content for the brand.
ideas.other_uk_rules: ASA/CAP rules on misleading AI-generated imagery in ads. Contract/IP licensing terms for generated likenesses.

idea.name: Faceless AI niche topic pages
idea.one_liner: Faceless social pages on a topic (e.g. Formula 1) using AI-generated content, earning from platform payouts and affiliates.

key_quotes.quote: Remember, it doesn't need to be a person that you're creating.
It could just be a topic like Formula 1 racing.

ideas.delivery: AI-generated videos/images about the topic, posted by the creator.
ideas.other_uk_rules: Copyright/trademark risk using F1 or team branding and footage. ASA disclosure for affiliate posts.

stated_problem.quote: It's hard to become a millionaire just by getting paid from YouTube or Instagram or Facebook alone.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Off-platform monetisation of faceless audience
idea.one_liner: Use AI influencer accounts to drive traffic to a newsletter, email list, affiliate links, products, digital products or courses.
idea.revenue_model: Affiliate commissions, product/course sales, newsletter sponsorship

key_quotes.quote: But the bigger opportunity here is to start a newsletter or collect email addresses or use affiliate links or sell products or digital products or courses or whatever through these accounts.
The big money is in driving that traffic off platform or to you or acquiring their emails etc.

acquisition_channels.details: Traffic from AI influencer accounts pushed off-platform

ideas.delivery: Digital: email newsletter, affiliate links, digital products/courses sold to the audience.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR and PECR consent for marketing emails to the collected list. Consumer Contracts Regs and DMCC Act rules if selling digital products/subscriptions. ASA affiliate disclosure.
